# SC Precision Deburring

> Hand and microscope deburring for aerospace and precision machine shops in Pacoima, Los Angeles (San Fernando Valley), California. Legal name SC Deburring LLC.

SC Precision Deburring is a deburring-only shop. We hand-deburr complex machined parts under 10x to 40x magnification: cross-drilled and intersecting bores, internal fluid passages, threaded ports, manifolds, valve bodies and tight edge-break callouts, without changing critical dimensions. Customers are precision machine shops serving aerospace, defense, medical and industrial programs, who use us as overflow capacity. Every lot gets a final inspection under magnification and ships with a Certificate of Conformance. We are not ISO 9001 or AS9100 certified.

- Address: 12734 Branford St, Unit 17, Pacoima, CA 91331
- Phone: (818) 389-4234
- Email: quotes@scprecisiondeburring.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 6:00 AM to 5:00 PM
- Quotes: within one business day, free, no minimum order
- Service area: San Fernando Valley and Santa Clarita pickup and delivery; freight across Southern California
